# pve_acme_plugins (Data Source)

Lists the ACME challenge plugins configured on the cluster (`GET /cluster/acme/plugins`), including the built-in `standalone` plugin. DNS plugin instances can be managed with `pve_acme_dns_plugin`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_acme_plugins" "all" {
  type = "dns"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Only list plugins of this challenge type. Must be one of: `dns`, `standalone`.

### Read-Only

- `plugins` (Attributes List) Every visible ACME plugin. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins))

<a id="nestedatt--plugins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins`

Read-Only:

- `api` (String) DNS API plugin name (dns plugins only).
- `data` (String, Sensitive) DNS plugin data (base64-encoded credentials); dns plugins only.
- `digest` (String) Digest of the plugin configuration file.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the plugin config is disabled.
- `nodes` (List of String) Cluster nodes the plugin is limited to; empty means all nodes.
- `plugin` (String) Unique identifier of the plugin instance.
- `type` (String) ACME challenge type of the plugin.
- `validation_delay` (Number) Extra delay in seconds before requesting validation.
